From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.

people.name: Zered
people.line: A brook marking the end of Israel's wilderness wanderings

translations.web: “Now rise up, and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.
translations.bsb: “Now arise and cross over the Brook of Zered.” So we crossed over the Brook of Zered.
translations.kjv: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
translations.asv: Now rise up, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
